name: SP-12 slow knock
desc: 90s R&B knock on EmuSP12 lo-fi drums: heavy kick on 1 and the and-of-3, cracking snare on 2&4, swung 16th hats via patterned lateness (never .swing), rimshot ghosts. Mary J two-stepping at 91 BPM - dusty, warm, unhurried.

gain.doc: kick level, other layers scale from it

swing.doc: hat lateness in cycles - swing amount

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] [bd ~]").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.3), s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.6).room(.28), s("hh*16").bank("EmuSP12").late("[0 ${swing} 0 ${swing}]*4").gain("[.4 .14 .26 .14]*4").pan(cosine.range(.44,.58).slow(9)), s("rim*16").bank("EmuSP12").degradeBy(.86).gain(.18).pan(.4), s("[~ ~ ~ oh]").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.35).lpf(5000).pan(.6).mask("<0 1 0 1>")).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] [bd bd]").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.35), s("~ sd ~ [sd sd]").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.64).room(.28), s("hh*16").bank("EmuSP12").late("[0 ${swing} 0 ${swing}]*4").gain("[.44 .18 .3 .18]*4").pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(7)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("rim*16").bank("EmuSP12").degradeBy(.8).gain(.2).pan(.38), s("[~ ~ ~ oh]").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.42).lpf(6000).pan(.62)).orbit(1).play()
